messages:
Sarah L.: Quick follow-up from the Orchid dedicated outage postmortem — root cause: intermittent VPC peering flaps + on-prem MTU/NAT edge case that triggered tenant isolation. Need clear owners + timelines for action items. ping @Miguel @Anika @Ellie

Miguel R.: I'll own peering stabilization (BGP keepalive tuning, route dampening, and peer MTU alignment). Est: infra changes in 10 business days, then 3-day canary. JIRA INFRA-2148

Anika V.: I'll take runtime isolation bug -> investigate how KV-cache/fallback wasn't used when peering flapped. Repro steps collected. Expect RC PR in 5 business days, rollout in 2 weeks behind canary.

Ellie C.: I'll coordinate Orchard approvals and maintenance windows. They prefer Wed/Thu evenings. I'll confirm two 1-hr canaries and get signed comms today.

Priya K.: I'll add alerting for peering flaps and a recurring query to detect pattern (freq > 3 flaps / 24h). Will update escalation policy to page infra on first flap. Ticket SRE-905.

Tom P.: I'll update the Dedicated runbook and customer-facing SLA appendix to include peering failure modes and handoff checklist. Copy draft by EOD Friday.

Sarah L.: Consolidated action items (owners -> deadlines):
1) Peering stability (Miguel) -> infra changes + canary -> due 2026-04-14
2) Runtime fallback fix (Anika) -> PR + canary rollout -> due 2026-04-08
3) Customer coordination (Ellie) -> canary window confirmed -> due 2026-04-01
4) Alerting/escalation (Priya) -> alerts + paging -> due 2026-03-30
5) Runbook + docs (Tom) -> draft + publish -> due 2026-03-27
6) CIDR/overlap audit (Miguel + Ellie) -> one-off audit of Orchard addresses -> due 2026-03-29

Priya K.: Also proposing a recurring incident-pattern digest — weekly automated report of isolation-related incidents across Dedicated/Private customers for 90 days. Will prototype next week.

Miguel R.: Quick snippet I ran to check overlapping ranges on the peering host: ```
# check cidr overlap
python -c "import ipaddress; print(any(ipaddress.ip_network('10.0.0.0/16').overlaps(ipaddress.ip_network(x)) for x in ['10.0.5.0/24','172.16.0.0/12']))"
```

Anika V.: Repro notes: when peering flapped, the runtime attempted to fail over but the KV cache entry TTL + delayed route install caused a transient split-brain. Will add preflight check to detect routing asymmetry before promoting fallback.

Ellie C.: Orchard asked for a rollback plan and SLA credits calc template — I'll loop legal + finance. They want the numbers before we run the first canary.

incident-bot: Timeline summary and linked tickets posted to #incident-archive: INFRA-2148, SRE-905, RUNTIME-339

Sarah L.: Meeting to confirm handoffs: Friday 2026-03-26 10:00am PT. Invite sent. Please update your ticket checklists before the meeting. :calendar:

Miguel R.: noted. I'll post a short runbook diff in the ticket ahead of the meeting.

Tom P.: Will include a short customer comms template in the runbook.

Priya K.: I'll wire up the alert query and share dashboards in #eng-sre by Tue.

Anika V.: Adding unit tests for the routing detection, PR link once ready.

Sarah L.: Thanks all — goal is to close visible action items within two weeks and have a repeatable playbook so this doesn't recur. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
